topics.topic: Default page size policy for each list in `get_repair_view` when no explicit size/continuation is provided
questions: What exact page size does `get_repair_view` use for each of its three lists (trial cases, trial executions, node executions): fixed default, fixed max, or caller-provided?
Without continuation and without an explicit size input, what exact page size does get_repair_view use for each of the three lists?

topics.topic: Deterministic refusal reason ordering when multiple preconditions/failures apply
questions: What is the mandatory check order (and therefore first refusal reason) when multiple grant preconditions fail?
If multiple services violate this start check, which one must be reported as the refusal reason?

topics.topic: How `functions.read_slot` handles list-sized verdict history data (paging requirement/exemption and retrieval mechanism)
questions: Is `read_slot` intentionally exempt from paging, or must it be paged like other list-shaped outputs?
How can `functions.read_slot` obtain the full verdict history per implementation if it cannot call `page_records` and `read_records` exposes only single-verdict lookup?

topics.topic: How owner-approval waiting states map to approval records when records are missing or history is ambiguous
questions: Must `approval_id` be present for every `owner_approval` waiting point, and what is returned if the element is waiting for approval but no `requested` approval record exists yet?

When an element has multiple historical `not_applied` resolutions, does "after it" mean after the latest such resolution or after the specific resolution tied to the immediately preceding unknown/not_applied path?

topics.topic: What response-validation schema is guaranteed to be available to `service_invoker.send_prepared_request`
questions: Which response schema/port declarations are guaranteed to be available to `send_prepared_request` so it can validate outputs and classify `contract_violation` vs `succeeded` deterministically?
What exact response-validation schema (binding output ports, carriage/cardinality/media-type rules) is guaranteed to be inside "prepared request" versus passed separately?

topics.topic: Whether owners are allowed to see implementation code (vs only metadata) in implementation-reading APIs
questions: For owner callers of `get_slot`/`functions.read_slot`, does the implementation list include code bodies or only identities/metadata?
For get_implementation, does the owner receive implementation code, or is code removed for both owner and agent?

topics.topic: Scope of trial evidence included in `get_repair_view` (full slot history vs current contract/implementation only)
questions: Should repair view include trial cases/executions across the slot's history, or only current contract/current implementation evidence?

topics.topic: `runs.continue_after_approval` behavior after owner refusal (re-enter element or finalize directly)
questions: After an owner refusal, must runs.continue_after_approval still call reach_operation_element, or only derive run end-state without re-reaching the element?
